name: The Market at 76067
summary: The Market at 76067 is a unique 12,000 square foot showroom in historic downtown Mineral Wells featuring over 100 vendors offering home décor, gifts, apparel, antiques, and artisan goods. The market includes an adjoining Coffee & Cocktail Bar, creating a distinctive shopping and social experience.
demographics: The Market at 76067 attracts a diverse mix of visitors from Mineral Wells and surrounding Palo Pinto County, primarily serving middle-income families and retirees drawn to the area's historic charm and small-town atmosphere. The customer base skews toward women aged 35-65 with household incomes ranging from $40,000-$75,000, including both local residents and tourists visiting Mineral Wells' historic downtown district. Shoppers are typically seeking unique, artisanal goods and handcrafted items rather than mass-market products, with a strong preference for supporting local vendors and discovering one-of-a-kind home décor and gifts.
description: The Market at 76067 is a distinctive shopping destination located in the heart of historic downtown Mineral Wells, Texas, offering a curated collection of over 100 unique vendors under one roof. This 12,000 square foot showroom transforms the traditional shopping experience into an exploration of artisan goods, antiques, and locally-sourced products. The market features an impressive variety of merchandise including home décor, gifts, men's accessories, jewelry, bath and body products, women's apparel, custom oil and vinegar selections, fresh produce, nuts and candies, and carefully selected antiques. What sets The Market at 76067 apart is its adjoining Coffee & Cocktail Bar, creating a social atmosphere where shoppers can relax and enjoy beverages while browsing through custom rooms and open showroom spaces. The venue celebrates the character of Mineral Wells' historic downtown while providing a modern, boutique-style shopping experience that appeals to both locals and visitors seeking unique finds and supporting small vendors.
